activity-date.narrative: REG Asia 2 is a Central American Network that aims to strengthen advocacy capacities of the network members. Through a regional laboratory for the creation of new narratives in favour of sexual and reproductive rights in Central America, with priority given to the abortion agenda. These actions will contribute to building narratives that reivindicate reproductive justice, the citizenship of the body and the autonomy to decide for women, young people and gender-diverse people. Among the activities to be carried out is a workshop with leaders in the region to build new arguments on based on international standards on SRHR. Once the inputs are available, two face-to-face meetings will be held with activists to share, validate and refine the analyses carried out. Project objective: to contribute and strenghen the conversation on sexual and reproductive rights from communication logics that recover humour and irreverence with the use of creative forms of communication, with the aim to attract new audiences in Central American.
